Questions

Good questions.

Do I pay anything to join the waitlist?

No. Joining is free and we don’t ask for payment info. You’ll hear from us before Liine opens.

What do founding families get?

The first 200 families get 50% off year one, and more founding perks as we launch.

Can grandparents give Liine as a gift?

Yes. Choose “Grandparent” when you join, add your grandchild’s first name, and we’ll help you set it up and invite the parents when we open.

Does the family need an app?

No. Family and close friends text your child’s number like any other number. No app, no new account, and it’s free for them.

Is this social media?

No. There are no followers, no ads and no public posts. Only the people you add can text your child’s Liine.
